scope: Common evidence.export preparation/execution and report operation inspection/cancellation/watch for the qualified ordinary retained acquisition/verification join. Native Windows prototype; no stable production ABI, physical storage or custody authority.
selection: Prepare retains the existing case operation/directory, output/store and four disclosure booleans. Supplying both collection_path and collection_digest explicitly selects the joined report; either alone is invalid. Absent both retains acquisition-only meaning. Execute binds definition version 1 or 2 explicitly; no source selection or disclosure edits may accompany execute.
grant: Version 2 requires exact outer definition_digest and allow_case_read, allow_collection_read, allow_report_write, allow_store_write and allow_host_effects all true before invoking an execution port. Version 1 retains its four flags and forbids collection authority. Inner digests, missing/false flags, unknown fields, scope/version confusion and changed reviewed content do not authorize effects.
producers: Existing acquisition-only result schemas retain their meaning. Joined preparation and execution/observation result schemas use version 2, bind the version-2 definition and exact state/outcome/receipt relationships, and declare custody_authentication/current_image_state/power_loss_persistence/authenticity not_established. Recorded verification and output completion never imply current-image or authenticated custody claims. An unresolved observation without a validated definition must not guess an acquisition-only or joined scope.
service: Select the existing contained report role through the inward service. Validate exact preparation source paths/digests, disclosure selection and output/store locations before returning review. Preserve operation ID, exact review digest and explicit state routing on unresolved execution. A completed observation is independent of logical output completion. Matching re-execution observes the same retained operation; no observer timeout/departure, cancellation request or missing terminal record authorizes replay.
budgets: Check complete public envelopes, callbacks, NDJSON LF frames, response slots, JSON/human rendering and retained frontend current/earlier views. The one-MiB wire frame and finite request/history/watch budgets remain unchanged. Both report profiles use explicit report-response classification and the existing expanded response/render budgets. A valid bounded response must not fail only because an intermediate caller used a smaller default. Malformed/oversized results preserve separately observed operation/routing facts as unknown.
watch: Keep the report.operation event family, exact header/operation/attempt/worker/process binding, cursor/digest replay and optional negotiated streaming. Snapshots and new records remain distinct. Shared state/record version 2 and exact native history checks bind either explicitly supported definition. Unknown critical generations refuse; compatible read does not admit an old writer. Cancellation request/observation, output facts, history completeness and process exit remain separate.
qualification: Define expectations before evaluating code. Build/run actual CLI, stdio, GUI, TUI and shell prepare/execute/watch using generated acquisition plus actual retained verification; compare exact independent support bytes and histories, verify actual worker exit and preserve input metadata. Retain source/code/store/disclosure/grant refusal tests and occupied-request/late-completion evidence. Exercise complete-envelope, channel and rendering bounds using separately labelled synthetic producers. Preserve acquisition-only regressions. No schema/spec-only check qualifies a frontend or storage effect.
remaining: Full DE-W034 case/report formats, complete 0.1.0 platform/storage scope, owner acceptance, physical/power-loss and privilege/release gates remain separately unverified. Additional report sources or stable API admission require their own contracts/evidence.
